items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Yeah, well Jim, Paul Barnes, Sidney Flusia played the guitar, Benny Turner played the piano, Robert Davis played the drum. It was six of us.

ctx.x: And where? In New Orleans. Exactly what street? Do you know?
Well, I think it was Boybin Street. Yeah. Near what? Near uh, St. Claude. Now Paul, though.
No, it was Boybin at that time. Yeah, but now Paul, though. It's Paul, but that's right. Now. So, uh, did you grow up here in the city?
